sloka: त्वरिताः शीघ्रमभ्येत्य कौसल्यायै न्यवेदयन् ।सा हिरण्यं च गाश्चैव रत्नानि विविधानि च ॥२-३-४७॥
transliteration: tvaritāḥ śīghramabhyetya kausalyāyai nyavedayan ।sā hiraṇyaṁ ca gāścaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥2-3-47॥

translations.english: ﻿ The foremost of women, Kausalya ordered gifts of gold, cows and various kinds of gems to be given to the messengers who brought this good tiding.
